$comment: Tenant #0 (DalaTech) test set for the founder's native read, and the source of the permanent reply_cases rows in scripts/provision/dalatech-reply-cases.sql (generated from this file by scripts/replycases/sql.ts; a unit test fails when the two drift). Tenant #0 had ten real inbound messages when this was written (2026-09-25); the three used here as written are marked `real` («ci henbe» is already active reply case 10 and is not repeated), every other message is CONSTRUCTED to cover a topic no customer has asked yet, in the style the real ones use (short, lowercase, Latin-typed Mongolian beside Cyrillic). Assistant turns in a `history` are ONLY text the bot serves verbatim — the price_overview row, a published FAQ answer — never a model reply written by hand. `expected_body` is set only where a deterministic row answers exactly (price_overview, assistant_who); rewording either row means updating those cases too. Forbidden phrases are the POSITIVE forms only («Эхо одоо ажиллаж байна»): a substring test cannot see negation, and «Эхо одоо ажиллаж эхлээгүй», the right answer, failed v01 under the old «Эхо одоо ажилла» (founder, 2026-09-26). Facts: only Дали is built; Вира, Эхо, Нова and Ора are coming soon with pre-registration (founder, 2026-09-25 — the live rows had marked Вира ИДЭВХТЭЙ and were corrected the same evening). The demo page https://app.dalatech.online is a contact point (`demo_url`, 0052). No phone number is published. Numerals are checked by production's own outbound guard; the report adds a report-only allow-list check on top.
